tei:div.tei:p: (327) ༄༅/ gnam chos rten gsum rab gnas 'don 'grigs/

bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i mjug tu rnam bum bsgrub/ khrus bum gyi dbus su sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer kun tu 'phro bas dri ma sbyong ba'i khrus chu nus ldan du gyur/ a bhi ṣi ka= bzla/ las bum gul yungs bdud rtsi 'khyil pas brlab/ bdag 'jug blang*/ zhi sbyong*/ sarba bighan= gsum/ phyed ma/ suṃbha ni= gsum/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i rten mchog 'di las= sogs/ sum bha ni= gul yungs dang gtor ma dor/ hūm̐/ steng yang= khrus kyi khang pa= ji ltar bltams pa= bdag gi dri ldan= 'di ni khrus mchog= de bzhin bshegs pa= ras 'jam dri dang= 'og gi hūm̐/ na bza'= hūm̐/ rin chen rgyan cha= phun sum tshogs pa'i= bkra shis brjod/ gong gi swa bhā ba= stong pa= rten 'di nyid bcom ldan che mchog sku mdog mthing nag rab tu= rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar bskyed/ hūm̐/ de yi gnas gsum= rgyal ba ye shes= med par thim/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs ma lus= a be shā ya a āḥ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i rten mchog 'di la ni= sogs/ rten gyi dbu la brgyan par gyur/ 'phros/ me tog dam pa= de dag bsngags pa= gong gi hūm̐/ gser gyi thur ma= sogs/ mig dbye/ snyan bru/ tshem shing*/ spu gri/ so mang*/ rmang mdzes/ rten 'brel bgyi bar mar blang*/ rten la reg cing se gol sgra dang yig brgya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hā/ lan gsum/ bskyed pa'i lha yongs su gyur pa rten so so'i rnam par gyur/ rten la gzungs thag gdags/ gnas bya'i rten rnams 328)kyi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rten so so'i rnam par byon nas de la bzhugs par gyur/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha= ye dhar= ci nus/ me tog gi 'bru re re nas rten 'brel snying po'i yig 'bru gser 'od 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ ye dharma= phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i= lan gsum/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra= hūm̐/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes=

rten mchog 'di la= badz+ra bar 'og nas 'byung ba yar blang*/ mnga' dbul gyi slad du/ ka dag klog nas= maṇ+ḍal/ sa gzhi spos chus= kun gyi gtso bo= gong gi hūm̐/ me tog bdug spos= rdzas brgyad/ sna bdun bcas/ bstod pas mnga' dbul ba/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i= mgon po thugs rje= phyag byar 'os pa= tsā ru'i bza' bas mnga' dbul ba/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan zhing= bkra shis/ ye dharma= phun sum tshogs pa= rol mo bsgrag las gzhung gi tshogs/ bsgral bstab skong ba yan bya/ chos skyong spyi dang bye brag rten de'i bdag po'i gtor bsngo gtang*/ gnyer gtad/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe dpal chen nyid kyi spyan snga ru// sangs rgyas bstan srung bar khas blangs ba'i// srung ma rnams kyis ji srid bskal pa'i bar// sku gsung thugs rten 'di la srung skyob mdzod// oṃ sarba dharma pā la sa ma ya rak+ṣaḥ zhes brjod/ tshogs lhag bskul pa/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni// gsol zhig sdig pa byang bar 'gyur/ /zhes brjod cing tsā ru'i bza' ba dang tshogs kyi zhal 329) zas dga' ston du rol/ rten la slar yang*/ me tog dam pa= sho lo ka gsum gyis mchod/ de dag bsngags pa= bstod/ ma 'byor pa dang= yig brgya lan gsum/ mdo'i smon lam bzang spyod/ sngags kyi smon lam bla ma yi dam rnams gtang*/ bkra shis tshigs bcad ji rigs pa brjod/ las byang gzhung gi bsngo smon/ bkra shis brjod pas mtha' brgyan no// zhes pa'ang skyil dgon du rang la nyer mkho'i phyir du pad+ma ma ṇis bris/ 'di nyid kyi bshams bkod ni/ rten gyi mdun du las gzhung gang la brten pa'i ras bris bkram pa'i dbus su/ mañdza'i khar/ rnam bum gzungs thag can/ mdun phyogs su rtsa gsum sogs phug gtor rnams dang*/ sman raka gtor ma zur gsum/ phyi mchod bskor bshams dang*/ mdun du zhi mchod g.yon nas mgo brtsams/

drag mchod g.yas nas mgo brtsams ste mjug sprod du bsham/ mañdza'i khar gsol ka gtor 'bul/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ chad tho g.yas/ brtan ma g.yon/ dkar bgegs gser skyems bcas bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas phyogs su/ mnga' dbul gyi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ tsā ru'i zhal zas/ gdugs ser pos brgyan pa'i mthar dkar mngar shing tog sogs bskor ba/ mchod pa bskor bshams/ bkra shis rdzas rtags sna bdun rnams bkod/ g.yon phyogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad khar khrus bum bcud ldan/ mchod pas bskor/ slob dpon mdun rdor dril/ gul yungs/ sbyong chas/ las bum sogs 'du bya'o// dge'o// 330)
